description: Claude Code skills by Hamdi Laadhari, installable one at a time.

plugins.name: repo-glowup
plugins.description: Audit and upgrade a repo's discoverability: README, badges, package metadata, social preview card, CI, CHANGELOG/CONTRIBUTING, GitHub description and topics, and an optional landing page.

plugins.name: devto-post
plugins.description: Research, draft and load a dev.to article in your voice, wait for you to publish it by hand, then draft the LinkedIn promo and schedule it once you approve. Asks for your dev.to details on first use.
